name: You.com
summary: Hosted You.com MCP for real-time web search, full-page content extraction, multi-step research with citations, finance and market data, and You.com integration discovery. Uses a You.com API key as a bearer token. Calls draw on your You.com API usage. Grant only the individual tools you want.
license: Proprietary service; see You.com Terms of Service
setup_instructions: Create an API key at https://you.com/platform/api-keys. In Open Dots, connect this listing and save the key as its bearer token. The default tool set is you-search, you-contents, you-research, you-finance, and you-discover. Grant only the individual tools each agent needs; you-research and you-contents can use more API credits than you-search. Do not paste the key into chat or a tool argument. Documentation: https://you.com/docs/welcome
test_instructions: Grant you-search to an agent and call it once with a short query such as "Model Context Protocol" and a result count of 1. A successful call returns web results with titles, URLs, and snippets. An authentication error means the saved bearer token is missing or invalid. Remove the grant if the agent does not need the search tool.
